poema.texto:
_______________________
                                                                                                   
                         ______
        ________  ______                                                                   __ 
     ___~         __\   ___~               Belleza, una luz dorada que se propaga  
     ~~                           ~~ 
              ________                                                               _____  ____
                           ________  ____                                    ___~~~~~
        ________                                 
 _Belleza, una flor que crece entre el cielo y la tierra_

       _____________________  _____
    ____               ________      
    Belleza está en  
               el canto  
                 del viento  
                                       __~~~~~~ 
                  Belleza, una onda
                    dulzura de las mareas
